metaTitle: How to Choose a Kids' Sleeping Bag
description: Pick a kids' sleeping bag by temperature rating, length, shape and insulation, with age-by-age tips and a sleep kit checklist for family camping.
directAnswer: Choose a kids' bag rated 10 degrees colder than the expected low, about 6 to 12 inches longer than your child, and usually synthetic for easy washing. Pair it with an insulated pad, a hat and dry layers.
